answer_1.quote: We evaluate four representative sLLMs from different model families: GLM4-9B-Chat, Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct (AI@Meta, 2024), Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate responses to value-based questions, including multiple-choice selections, confidence scores, and free-form justifications.

answer_2.quote: We use the Pearson correlation coefficient to examine the relationship between model confidence and value stability.

answer_3.quote: We conduct stance classification on 200 randomly sampled PVQ40 items and 200 value decision items using Llama3-70B-Instruct, GPT-4o, and Deepseek-R1 (DeepSeek-AI, 2025).

answer_4.quote: Second, performing human evaluation on the full PVQ40 questionnaire and a randomly sampled subset of 300 items from the INVP dataset. Three undergraduate annotators completed the questionnaires using both original and paraphrased prompts.
answer_4.guideline: The consistency rates of their choices were 95% for PVQ40 and 90.88% for the INVP dataset, indicating a high level of semantic equivalence across versions.
